recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not re-add DSTU1 enable-when extension prose to the current build because the behavior is now represented by core Questionnaire.item.enableWhen and later QuestionnaireResponse decisions confirm the current item.answer.item structure. Future changes should come from new Questionnaire/SDC tracker decisions, not FHIR-6906.
issue_request: FHIR-6906 was a Published FHIR-core QuestionnaireAnswers change request asking how to nest questions under answers and whether QuestionnaireAnswers.group.question.answer should have a group child. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution said this was possible through the enable-when extension and that Questionnaire notes should call out this and other complex-workflow aids, while keeping the linkage on the Questionnaire side unless evidence showed it was insufficient.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN #5941. Git commit 26e8b597d5034f4372a848e5660a88268f4b664c is the corresponding git-svn commit and explicitly lists {#6906}; it added Questionnaire notes saying the conditional display extension [enable-when] can enable groups nested beneath a question based on a specific answer, giving questions-under-answers behavior.
additional_context: Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. Later commit 52dbc1c47868e26651369ea4109008738f17ce5e refactored Questionnaire/QuestionnaireResponse into the current item model and retained nested-question semantics. Later Published issues FHIR-10481 and FHIR-20768 retained QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.item with clarification, FHIR-34184 added diagram guidance for nesting items within answers and repeated items, and FHIR-32665 clarified answer.value cardinality when answers contain child items. Zulip discussions align with that rationale, and direct FHIR-6906/community searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. Current Questionnaire has core Questionnaire.item.enableWhen for answer-dependent enablement, notes that questions may be nested under groups or questions, and SDC guidance for advanced question flow. Current QuestionnaireResponse distinguishes item.item for group children from item.answer.item for children of a specific answer, preserving the behavior the seed requested and later decisions refined.
